name: exculpatory-sentence-is-a-claim
description: The "what is NOT wrong here" line in a defect report is itself an unaudited claim, and it is the one that gets believed

When filing a defect I add a paragraph absolving the rest — "the docstring does
NOT overclaim; I checked that before flagging". That sentence is a **theorem
nobody proved**, and it is worse than silence: it makes the surrounding prose
look audited, so the next reviewer skips exactly the text I waved through.
